integrity: The proof gives exact finite stationary weights and asymptotic estimates; finite diagnostic tests do not certify infinite limits. The published result does not claim independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Stationary asymptotics for an exactly critical constant-rate, directed-ring zero-range model; growing but subextensive identical defects only. Extreme-value conclusion needs a stronger logarithmic growth hypothesis. Historical priority remains provisional because the full text of Rafferty (2016) and Zeng (2014) was not reliably accessible.
title: Mesoscopic mass and extremal occupancy at a growing collection of critical zero-range defects
